verdict.rationale: Jina Reader has no documented sandbox or test mode. The closest substitute is the prebuilt open-source container image (headless Chrome, LibreOffice, fonts), which lets you run Reader locally in isolation from the hosted SaaS. The code builder lets you explore parameter combinations before integrating. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment or test API keys, documentation on separating test from production usage, and any hands-on corroboration of using the self-hosted image this way.
